items.name: Glimmer Kiss
items.color: Clear in the bottle, turns pink on lips

voice.tagline: From a young entrepreneur who's a LIP GLOSS BOSS
signature-lines: Big dreams look good in gloss.
must-be-true: Glosses are sheer; never promise full coverage.
Only Glimmer Kiss has sparkle; no glimmer/shimmer/sparkle/glitter words for other glosses.
Glimmer Kiss turns pink in a few seconds.
Glimmer Kiss turns pink on skin (lips, back of hand); on glass, acrylic or paper it stays clear.
Every gloss is vanilla flavored; never 'flavors'.
There are 5 glosses; Love is discontinued.
Glimmer Kiss is not the only or first pH gloss.
Never guess ingredients; vitamin E is not used.
No plumping, healing, hydrating, long-lasting or 24-hour claims.
Charlie Mae: first name only; no age, school, town or photo in ads.
JC approves every post before it goes anywhere.

creative-direction.bar: Treat every ad like a $50,000 luxury beauty campaign.

sensory-focus: sun or flash reflections in the acrylic bottle
type-and-layout: display type layered with the product

concepts.A: High-Fashion Editorial: minimal, sculptural, studio light
concepts.B: Raw Flash / Paparazzi Candid: direct flash, 35mm grain, effortless

critique-gate.question: Does this look like a web banner?
critique-gate.on-fail: rewrite the concept and re-render; do not just nudge sizes

truth-rules: Glimmer Kiss is clear with sparkle on any surface; pink only on skin (lips, back of hand)
the bottle has no label; any label, logo or text in a result is a reject
no AI faces; never send Charlie's photo to fal
every AI picture gets a .json sidecar marking it AI-made
cost-rules: animate only an approved hero image

bottle-logo.$description: LOCKED 2026-11-11. JC set the rule and Charlie confirmed the centered position the same day. Where the logo sits on the bottle in every picture and video. Always applied with tools/bottle_logo.py, never by eye. All measures are along the bottle's length, on the center line of the FRONT face.
bottle-logo.wordmark-position: centered on the clear bottle, both ways. Same clear gap under the cap as at the bottom.
bottle-logo.monogram-direction: LOCKED (JC and Charlie, 2026-11-11): GB stands UPRIGHT on the cap. It sits across the cap, a quarter turn from GLIMMER BLISS, with the top of the letters toward the end of the cap. Its width is 38% of the cap's length (about three quarters of the cap's front face).
bottle-logo.monogram-position: centered on the white cap, both ways.
bottle-logo.direction: LOCKED (JC, 2026-11-11): GLIMMER BLISS always reads from the bottom of the bottle toward the cap, in every ad, picture and video, whatever way the bottle is lying. GB stands upright on the cap (see monogram-direction). The bottle is never turned to fix the logo.
bottle-logo.tolerance: within 1% of the bottle length (about 4 px on a 1080 px wide picture)
bottle-logo.status: Until the printed labels arrive. Then measure a real bottle and change these numbers to match it.

layout-phi.$description: JC, 2026-11-11: nothing centered. Place things on the phi grid (golden ratio, 1.618). The phi grid is like the rule of thirds but its lines sit at 38.2% and 61.8%, a little closer to the middle.
rules: The bottle's center line (or its logo) sits on a phi line, never on the middle of the frame.
Words sit on the other side of the frame from the bottle. Line up a text edge or a baseline with a phi line.
Type sizes step by 1.618: small words x 2.618 = headline, headline x 2.618 = the big word.
When two blocks share a space, split it 61.8 / 38.2, not half and half.
layout-phi.honesty: A phi grid is a placing guide, not proof that a layout is beautiful. Still judge the result by eye.
